utterances.text: I crossed this junction and I ran towards the creek.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: In which direction was the creek? Can you just draw an arrow.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: If you could just make sure the arrowhead is there somewhere. Could you put those two pointy bits to show it's an arrow?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: [Marks].

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Now, what happened while you were -- ran in that direction? What happened to your mother and brother and sister?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: They followed me.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes. Then what happened next?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Soldiers caught up with them at the junction.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Which junction?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: This one in the photograph.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: So the soldiers caught up with them at this junction and you had run where the arrow is pointing; is that correct? I just want to be quite clear so Their Honours can follow your evidence.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: So now you are separated, are you not, from the rest of your family?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Okay. What happened?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: The soldiers caught up with them.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: My mother begged them to let them go and not kill them.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Now, before we come to that. How come you hear -- how is it that you were hearing this? Where were you yourself?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I was perhaps six or seven metres away from the junction, concealed in the bushes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: And is that the same direction where you have marked that arrow?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: So you were hiding there?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Right. You -- now we go back to what you heard your mother say. Can you try to please recall - and I'm aware it can't be very easy for you - what exactly your mother did say to these soldiers.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: She begged them not to kill them and to let them go.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: And what was the response to this plea?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I didn't hear what they said. The next thing I heard was the soldiers talking, saying, What shall we do with the women and children?

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes. So was this like one soldier asking another soldier? Did you hear one voice and then another voice?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Just one voice.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Could you observe them from your vantage point, from where you were hiding? Could you see them or could you just hear them?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Just hear them.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes. And what did you -- if you can again remember what you heard the soldiers say in exactly the same words, if you can of course.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I heard them talking and a soldier asked, What should I do with the women and children?

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: The next thing I heard there was an order to kill anyone they captured. I heard them mentioning Eniz Hujdur and Enver Buza.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Now, you said you heard an order to kill anyone they captured. Now, who was this order from and how did you hear it? Do you remember the voice?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I heard a voice saying that all those captured must be killed.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Okay. And who did you hear mention Eniz Hujdur and Enver Buza?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: One of those soldiers there.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: In what context did they mention these two names?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I can't remember exactly.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: No, I understand. It has been some time. So we are very grateful to you to recall as best as you can under very difficult circumstances. Now, did you know who Eniz Hujdur was?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Eniz Hujdur, as far as I knew, was a member of the BH army.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: How -- did you know him at that time when his name was mentioned?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I had known him before the war while he still went to school.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Were you in school together?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: No. We were schoolmates but not classmates, so I saw him around the school.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: So you knew who he was?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: And what about the Enver Buza? Did you know who he was when you heard that name, Enver Buza?

utterances.speaker: MARKO ZELIC
utterances.text: I didn't know. I only learned later.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Your Honours, this might be a convenient place to break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. Well, Witness, I'm afraid that you have to stay in The Hague for another day --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: -- and I have to warn you that now you are under the oath, so do not talk to anybody and do not let anybody talk to you about your testimony and we'll see you tomorrow afternoon. Do you understand that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Yes. And we have a housekeeping matter to deal with. That is the photograph marked by the witness should be tendered and dealt with.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Your Honour, the junction one, the close-up, I was going to have the witness mark more things on it. So could we wait until he's completed his markings? Or I could tender this one now and use another one.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We can mark it for identification as MFI 357.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. So we'll resume tomorrow afternoon at 4.30, I guess. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. CHANA
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 13th day of April, 2005, at 4.30 p.m. 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.00 p.m.,
